# Copilot Agent Instructions (Project-level)

This file contains short, live guidance for GitHub Copilot agents working in purrfectsoft/click. Keep it minimal and update frequently as the project evolves.

- Purpose: Provide high-level rules for automated or human-invoked Copilot agents.
- When picking up an issue: comment on the issue to acknowledge, link any PRs, and summarize planned changes.
- PRs: Always open a pull request for code or documentation changes. Link the issue number in the PR description.
- Files: Use repository file blocks when proposing file changes in chat. Keep changes small and well-documented.
- Reviews: Request a human reviewer (mention @purrfectsoftltd) before merging unless the change is trivial documentation.
- Privacy & Security: Respect the project's privacy-first constraints. Do not add analytics, trackers, or external telemetry.
- Escalation: If unsure, leave the issue for a human. Tag @purrfectsoftltd for guidance.

This file is intentionally short — expand with project-specific guidance in `.github/instructions/`.
